title: Times Table Row
prompt: n = 7 is given. Print the 7-times table from 1x to 3x as three lines: 7 / 14 / 21 — with range().

tests.name: three multiples
tests.code:
assert printed == ["7", "14", "21"], f"got {printed}"
assert "range(" in code, "use range()"
tests.hint: for i in range(1, 4): print(n * i)
